name: opendss_altdss_library

support_targets.opendss: EPRI OpenDSS; online documentation is mixed-version

validation.source_review: Line/LineCode and Phase 3A passed independent QA/QC with findings. The required corrections are applied. Phase 3B package 1 passed coder source review, independent QA/QC with no blocking findings, and architect/auditor review. One optional citation-precision correction was applied (A-1). Owner disposition is pending.
validation.schema_validation: tools/validate_catalogs.py passed 10/10 manifest and catalog schema pairs (Draft 2020-12 with format checking, jsonschema 4.26.0) on 2026-11-21.
validation.runtime: All four catalogued examples ran successfully on 2026-11-21 on Windows 11 AMD64, Python 3.14.6, altdss 0.2.4, dss-python 0.15.7, and backend 0.14.5. Phase 3B package 1 has a recorded five-class readback matrix and focused setter and cable checks.

known_gaps: Three catalog files are still empty pending later phases: opendss_objects, python_interface_comparison, troubleshooting.

The generated altdss_python_api catalog covers object and collection classes and the AltDSS context. Non-element context interfaces, context batch proxies, and internal _str proxies are outside the catalog scope.
dss_capi.json covers Line, LineCode, LineGeometry, LineSpacing, WireData, CNData, and TSData, including shared conductor and cable fields.
Property-level source_refs remain partial for Line/LineCode (E-3 deferred); new element packages require per-row citations.
Fixture-based validation with IEEE 13- and 34-node circuits and golden results is planned for Phase 4; no golden fixtures exist yet.
The beta package line (AltDSS-Python 0.3.0b2 and later) is documented as future compatibility only and not validated.
EPRI online pages do not state one OpenDSS version; version-sensitive claims need release-specific confirmation.
The legacy line catalog and builder are retained for provenance and are not active inputs.
next_actions: Record the owner's disposition for Phase 3B package 1; independent QA/QC and the architect/auditor review passed, with optional correction A-1 applied. Package 2 (Circuit and Vsource) follows on the same template.
Extend dss_capi.json with each element package's enums, specification sets, scales, and constructor defaults.
Draft the Phase 4 golden fixture layout and harness before the first fixture is added.
